title: Thanksgiving Buffet at Devil’s Pool Restaurant
seo_title: Thanksgiving Buffet at Devil's Pool Restaurant, Ridgedale MO
description: This is a Thanksgiving buffet at Devil's Pool Restaurant, where you can eat traditional holiday favorites and southern homestyle cooking in a century-old log structure. It takes place Thursday, November 26, 2026, from 11:00 AM to 8:00 PM at 190 Top of the Rock Rd in Ridgedale, Missouri.
address: 190 Top of the Rock Rd, Ridgedale, MO, 65739
